validation.protocol: Train on 2022–2023, calibrate ensemble weights/interval width on 2024, evaluate once on untouched 2025; expanding annual folds report stability separately.

featureSchema: prior source year's same no-leap hour index

modelEvidence.name: Prior-year seasonal naive
limitations: Assumes the previous no-leap year repeats hour-for-hour.

modelEvidence.name: 2022–2023 hourly climatology
limitations: Averages only two source years and cannot respond to evaluation-year weather.

modelEvidence.name: Meteorological ridge regression
limitations: Uses realised 2025 reanalysis or sample meteorology; this is a hindcast, not an issued year-ahead forecast.
Linear features cannot represent every nonlinear system response.

modelEvidence.name: Calibrated research ensemble
limitations: Weights and interval width are selected on 2024 and evaluated once on untouched 2025.
The target is physics-derived; champion promotion requires measured production evidence.

modelEvidence.name: Physical generation target
limitations: Defines the current target and therefore is not scored against itself as a competitive forecast.

evaluationStatus: retrospective previously-inspected 2025; not a new untouched evaluation
